classes.name: Create
classes.description: A utility class providing factory methods for creating different types of promises and iterators.

methods.name: promiseFor
methods.description: Creates a promise for a value if it is not already a promise, or returns the promise itself.

methods.name: rejectionFor
methods.description: Creates a rejected promise for a reason, or returns the reason if it is already a promise.

methods.name: exceptionFor
methods.description: Creates an exception object for a reject reason, or returns the reason if it is already a Throwable.

methods.name: iterFor
methods.description: Returns an iterator for the given value, wrapping arrays or single values as necessary.
